description: The TfL Unified API is Transport for London's REST interface to its open data. Its endpoint groups cover lines and their status, stop points, journey planning, vehicle arrivals, road corridors and disruptions, bike points of the cycle hire scheme, occupancy, places, accident statistics, air quality, travel times and taxi services. Modes in the API include bus, Tube, DLR, Elizabeth line, Overground, tram, national rail, river bus, cable car, coach, cycle hire, cycling, walking and taxi. Coverage is Greater London. Access: free; registration for an API key with the 500 requests plan is recommended, and use must follow TfL's transport data terms and conditions; a Swagger description is published for developers. Caveats: the API serves current and near real-time data, not long archives, so historical analysis needs data to be collected over time. It supports public transport network modelling, real-time digital twins, disruption and incident analysis and journey-time studies, and complements the PTAL grid and the London cycling infrastructure database catalogued here.
